description.text:
Get Ready for Blockbuster Fun

Once you step past the iconic Universal globe at the park entrance, brace yourself for heart-pounding rides, immersive shows, and an array of thrilling attractions inspired by your favourite blockbuster movies and beloved television shows like the Transformers series, Jurassic Park, and Puss in Boots. These attractions are a must-visit for all ages. Get ready for an adventure like no other—let the excitement and fun unfold!


Skip the Queue:

Don't like to queue? Skip the lines with Universal Studios Singapore Express Pass tickets!

highlights.text:
• Hop on thrill rides like Battlestar Galactica: HUMAN vs. CYLON™ or TRANSFORMERS The Ride: The Ultimate 3D Battle in Sci-Fi City.
  • Don't miss the Jurassic Park Rapids Adventure ride, one of the most unique experiences in Southeast Asia.
  • Enjoy exciting live entertainment and thrills at Southeast Asia's premier theme park, featuring award-winning interactive shows and adrenaline-pumping rides.
  • Keep an eye out for live performances while strolling around the park's themed areas; they are a must-see for all ages.
  • Get up close and personal with your favourite Universal Studios theme park characters and capture a picture or two with them.
  • Shop and dine at a variety of outlets around the park for a great time with family and friends.

operatingHours.heading: Operating Hours
operatingHours.text:
• Open daily from 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM.
  • Extended hours to 9:00 PM during Singapore school holidays and public holidays.
  • Operating hours for rides, shows, and the park may change without prior notice. Check the Universal Studios Singapore official website or Operating Calendar for updates, as hours may change without prior notice.
  • Selected rides, shows, street entertainment, meet-and-greet events, and experiences may be unavailable until further notice.

goodToKnow.heading: Must Know
goodToKnow.text:
• Skip the queue and save time at your favourite rides and attractions when you purchase Universal Express Passes.
  • Outdoor attractions may close temporarily during lightning risks, with no refunds provided.
  • No outside food or beverages are permitted, except for infants or special medical needs.
  • Only contactless payments are accepted, including Mastercard, Visa, American Express, Diners, JCB, Union Pay, NETS, GrabPay, WeChat Pay, Alipay, MPay, NETS Pay, PayNow, Singtel Dash, Genting Dollars, and RWS Vouchers.
  • Universal Express Passes are available for purchase to skip queues at select rides and attractions. For latest information on available rides, attractions, and experiences, please check for advisories.
  • Amber Rock Climb, Elmo's TV Time, Donkey Live, and WaterWorld are temporarily closed until further notice.
  • For the best experience, wear comfortable clothes and shoes. Bring a spare set of clothes, as some attractions may get you wet.
  • All sales and renewals of Annual and Season Passes are temporarily suspended.

eligibility.heading: Eligibility
eligibility.text:
• Tickets are valid for all guests with a valid QR code ticket. Each guest must scan their respective QR code at the entrance.
  • Guests must comply with ride-specific age, height, weight, and health restrictions, available in the Rider’s Guide or at each attraction.
  • The attraction reserves the right to request identification to verify ticket eligibility.

childpolicy.heading: Child Policy
childpolicy.text:
• Child tickets apply to ages 4 to 12.
  • Children under 122 cm in height must be accompanied by a Supervising Companion (aged 14 or older) who meets all ride requirements, except at Magic Potion Spin, where children under 110 cm need a parent or guardian.
  • Hand-held infants are not permitted on certain attractions for safety reasons.
  • Young children must walk to and from ride vehicle seats unassisted and have the body and spinal control to sit upright without aid.
  • The Child Swap Programme allows one parent to wait with a child while others ride, then swap without re-queueing. Contact attraction team members or Guest Services for details.
  • The Baby Care Centre at the park entrance offers nursing facilities, a baby changing area, and formula preparation stations.

accessibility.heading: Accessibility
accessibility.text:
• The park offers accessibility options for guests with disabilities. Refer to the Rider’s Guide for detailed safety and accessibility information.
  • Nursing facilities and a Baby Care Centre are available for families with young children.

bookingConfirmation.heading: Booking Confirmation
bookingConfirmation.text: Your booking will be confirmed by the provider instantly.

refundCancellationPolicy.heading: Cancellation Policy
refundCancellationPolicy.text:
• No cancellations and refunds are allowed for this activity.
  • Tickets are non-transferable, non-refundable, and not for sale or exchange, even in cases of inclement weather.

redemptionNotes.heading: Voucher Use
redemptionNotes.text:
Present your mobile ticket with QR code at the Universal Studios Singapore entrance gantry for direct park entry.

Upon booking confirmation, the admission ticket is valid only on the selected date.

aUniversalChristmas24Nov20254Jan2026.heading: A Universal Christmas (24 Nov 2025 - 4 Jan 2026)
aUniversalChristmas24Nov20254Jan2026.text:
Celebrate the holidays at Universal Studios Singapore with more than just thrilling rides! Enjoy Santa’s high-energy festive show featuring lights, music and magical snowfall. Watch the Far Far Away Castle transform at night with a stunning projection-mapping display, meet your favourite characters in their Christmas outfits, and savour limited-time festive treats throughout the park.


  • Santa’s Rockmas: Sleigh All Day: See Santa’s rockstar makeover with Elmo, Abby, and Cookie Monster, enjoy his new musical groove, magical snowfall, and a photo moment with the Sesame Street friends.
  • Santa’s Rockmas: Rock All Night: Join Shrek and the Penguins of Madagascar as they help Santa rock the stage; cheer to light up the 10-metre tree, New York Street, and enjoy a snowfall.
  • Lake Hollywood Christmas Fireworks: End the day with a dramatic fireworks show over Lake Hollywood, set to a powerful musical score.
  • Mel’s Merry Mixtape: Enjoy a lively performance of holiday hits from every decade by the Universal Singers.
  • A Despicably Merry Meet & Greet: Meet Gru, Lucy, the girls, and the Minions in festive outfits and snap a mischief-filled holiday photo.
  • DreamWorks Animation Holiday Spectacular: Be dazzled at night by a projection-mapping show that brings DreamWorks worlds to life on the Far Far Away Castle.
  • Jolly Ogre Meet & Greet: Visit Far Far Away to meet Shrek and Princess Fiona in their Christmas best for a fairytale photo.
  • Yuletide Yummies: Enjoy festive food across the park, from sweet treats to hearty Christmas mains.


The merriest event of the year awaits!

sections.question: How do I get to Universal Studios Singapore?
sections.answer: The best way to reach Universal Studios is by taking the train to HarbourFront MRT, then transferring to the monorail to Resorts World Station. If you're driving, parking is available at the Resorts World Sentosa car park. For a more scenic route, take the cable car, disembark at Imbiah Station, and then hop on the Sentosa Express, alighting one stop later at Resorts World Station.

sections.question: Can I buy Universal Studios Singapore tickets at the gate?
sections.answer: Absolutely! You can buy tickets at the booths by the entrance. Just keep in mind that getting a USS ticket depends on availability, and you might encounter long queues. For a smoother experience, guaranteed entry, better prices, and to avoid those pesky lines, it's a good idea to purchase your tickets online before you go.

sections.question: Are there any age or height restrictions for the rides at Universal Studios Singapore?
sections.answer: The minimum height requirement at Universal Studios Singapore is 92 cm. Children between 92 cm and 122 cm must be accompanied by a supervising companion. You can also check the height requirements on the official USS mobile app.

sections.question: Is Universal Studios Singapore child-friendly?
sections.answer: Yes, Universal Studios Singapore is child-friendly. Children aged 3 and below can enter for free, and ride restrictions are based on height, not age.

sections.question: Can I bring my own food and drinks into Universal Studios Singapore?
sections.answer: No, outside food and drinks are not permitted inside Universal Studios Singapore. However, there are plenty of food and beverage options available within the park, catering to a variety of preferences.

sections.question: Is there a dress code for Universal Studios Singapore?
sections.answer: There is no specific dress code for Universal Studios Singapore, but guests are encouraged to dress comfortably and appropriately for the weather and the attractions within the park.

sections.question: What types of rides are at Universal Studios Singapore?
sections.answer: Some popular rides at Universal Studios across the themed zones include Revenge of the Mummy, a high-speed roller coaster that goes backwards; Battlestar Galactica: Human vs. Cyclon, the most intense roller coaster in the park; and the Jurassic Park Rapids Adventure ride. Don't miss the Transformers Ride, Enchanted Airways, and Puss in Boots' Giant Journey as well; these are exciting attractions based on your favourite blockbuster films and television series.

sections.question: What is there to do in Minion Land Singapore?
sections.answer: At Minion Land in Universal Studios Singapore, you'll dive into the vibrant world of your favourite Despicable Me and Minions movies! Meet the cheeky Minions and enjoy some fun attractions. Don't miss Despicable Me Minion Mayhem—a thrilling 3D ride that takes you on a wild adventure! And be sure to hop on the Buggie Boogie carousel, where you can groove to catchy dance music remixed by the Minions.

sections.question: Is there a Wizarding World of Harry Potter in Universal Studios Singapore?
sections.answer: No, there are no Hogwarts-themed attractions at USS, including any experiences or rides related to the Wizarding World of Harry Potter.

sections.question: Are there any shows at Universal Studios Singapore?
sections.answer: Yes, Universal Studios offers a variety of shows on-site, including WaterWorld, The Dance for the Magic Beans, Lights, Camera, Action!, and the Shrek 4-D Adventure ride. The showtimes at USS vary, but most shows typically run for about 20 to 30 minutes.

sections.question: Is the Universal Studios Express Pass worth getting?
sections.answer: Yes, the USS Express Pass is worth getting and is extremely convenient for cutting waiting times. When you purchase the Universal Express Pass, you save time waiting in lengthy queues that feel like ages and can enjoy repeat rides and shows as many times as you want. After all, who doesn't like to skip queues, save time, or ride their favourite roller coaster again?

sections.question: How much is a meal at Universal Studios Singapore?
sections.answer: The price of a meal varies at Universal Studios eateries, but you can expect to pay roughly SGD 15 to SGD 20 for a single dish. For instance, Loui's Pizza, which serves New York-style food at USS, offers beef meatball mac and cheese for SGD 15 and spaghetti bolognese for SGD 14. Meanwhile, at Goldilocks, you can enjoy three pieces of fried chicken, a drink, and tater tots for SGD 18.50.

sections.question: Does Universal Studios Singapore have Muslim-friendly and Halal-certified dining options?
sections.answer: Yes, there are plenty of halal options at USS to indulge your taste buds. The park boasts a choice of three distinct halal restaurants, offering a variety of Western favourites and local delights—from the Egyptian-inspired Oasis Spice Café in the Ancient Egypt zone to the retro American-themed Mel's Drive-In.

sections.question: Which hotels are near USS?
sections.answer: Hotels near Universal Studios, such as Crockfords Tower, Hotel Michael, Hard Rock Hotel Singapore, Hotel Ora, and Equarius Hotel in the integrated resort, are all conveniently located within walking distance of the park.

sections.question: How much do Universal Studios Singapore ticket prices cost?
sections.answer: Universal Studios Singapore ticket prices start from SGD 83 for Standard Admission tickets and SGD 144 for the USS + SEAA Double Fun Package, which includes additional perks like admission to the S.E.A. Aquarium and meal vouchers.

sections.question: Is the Universal Studios Singapore VIP Pass worth it?
sections.answer: Yes, the Universal Studios VIP Experience is definitely worth it! It offers priority access to rides and shows, making you feel like a visiting celebrity and providing the ultimate theme park experience—think of it as an upgraded version of the Express Pass.

sections.question: Is the ticket for local residents or visitors (tourists/travellers)?
sections.answer: Unless otherwise stated in the product option, tickets can be used by both local residents and visitors
